_readme: The payload budget (GUIDELINES §2.5). `ceiling` is a HARD gate on the
built bundle's gzip bytes — tools/payload.mjs --check fails when the
build crosses it, and the suite runs that check on every verify.
Raising a ceiling is a DECISION: edit the number in the same commit
as the change that needs it, and say why in that commit's message.
`history` is the per-release record — append with
`node tools/payload.mjs --record vX.Y.Z` at tag time. Raw bytes are
recorded for parse-cost context; the ceiling is gzip because the wire
is what a first paint waits on.
Ceilings start at ~15% over the v0.12.0 measurement — headroom for a
normal slice, tight enough that a dependency or a generated blob
